title: Pay the mining remediation levy
what: As a mining operator under an environmental (mining) licence, pay the annual levy (1% of the mining security provided) into the Mining Remediation Fund.

sources.title: Legacy Mines Remediation Act 2023 (NT)
sources.quote: A mining operator who carries out mining activities under an environmental (mining) licence must pay an annual levy in accordance with this section and the regulations
